name: labs/michel4j__aunt-isara
title: ISARA sample automounter (AuntISARAApp)
intro: ISARA sample automounter (AuntISARAApp), adapted from michel4j/aunt-isara. It reads `status`, `action`, `position`, `tool` and 7 more; runs `select_mount_port`, `home` and `stop_all_motion`. `select_mount_port`: convert a dewar port into the native tool, puck and sample mount parameters and store it as the next port; this prepares a mount and does not move the robot. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/michel4j__aunt-isara --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/michel4j__aunt-isara --backend fake --mcp
